name: @zseven-w/dsh-ios
description: DeepSeek Harness plugin for the iOS Simulator — build, run, and interact with a live simulator stream inside a conversation. Tested with DSH 0.1.5-rc.1.

scripts.build: node scripts/run-tool.mjs tsc -p tsconfig.json && pnpm run build:client
scripts.build:client: node scripts/run-tool.mjs tsc -p tsconfig.client.json && node scripts/run-tool.mjs tsdown src/client/index.tsx --config tsdown.config.mjs --format cjs --platform browser --target es2022 --tsconfig tsconfig.client.json --out-dir .client-build --clean --sourcemap --logLevel warn && node scripts/build-client.mjs
scripts.typecheck: node scripts/run-tool.mjs tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/run-tool.mjs tsc -p tsconfig.client.json
scripts.test:qa-runtime: node scripts/dev-wda-physical-stage-smoke.mjs && node scripts/dev-usbmux-listener-probe-smoke.mjs && node scripts/dev-qa-physical-default-smoke.mjs && node scripts/dev-qa-sim-recovery-smoke.mjs && node scripts/dev-wda-simulator-input-release-subprocess.mjs
scripts.test: node scripts/dev-signing-smoke.mjs && node scripts/dev-devicectl-smoke.mjs && node scripts/dev-realtools-smoke.mjs && node scripts/dev-realstart-smoke.mjs && node scripts/dev-panel-smoke.mjs && node scripts/dev-wda-smoke.mjs && node scripts/dev-uitree-smoke.mjs && node scripts/dev-wda-simulator-input-smoke.mjs && node scripts/dev-wda-targeted-text-smoke.mjs && node scripts/dev-qa-driver-smoke.mjs && node scripts/dev-qa-physical-targeted-smoke.mjs && node scripts/dev-logs-smoke.mjs && node scripts/dev-debug-smoke.mjs && npm run test:qa-runtime

client.resolution: not exercised by the server/headless plugin entry

dshHostRuntime.note: Inert documentation only; host packages are intentionally absent from dependencies and peerDependencies.
